verdict.rationale: The evidence shows no user-definable rules engine that triggers actions on events. Order webhooks are an outbound event feed that the developer must build their own logic around, and they are registered server-side only through a partner manager, so they count as a building block rather than the capability itself. The UCP_ON_ESCALATION setting is a single fixed CLI behavior, and AP2 mandates are payment boundaries, not event-driven automation rules.
